narrative.intro: This ranking shows which industry markets grew fastest in federal contract obligations in FY2026 to date. Total federal contract obligations for the period were $225B. The list measures year-over-year growth for the same fiscal period and reports percentage changes in obligations. Commercial and Institutional Building Construction led the ranking with 181.7% growth, followed by Highway, Street, and Bridge Construction at 175.3% and Process, Physical Distribution, and Logistics Consulting Services at 116.4%. The top ten also include Automobile Manufacturing, Offices of Physicians (except Mental Health Specialists), Other Heavy and Civil Engineering Construction, Research and Development in Biotechnology (except Nanobiotechnology), Software Publishers, Water and Sewer Line and Related Structures Construction, and Guided Missile and Space Vehicle Manufacturing. All figures are contract obligations, and current-year totals are partial because the fiscal year is still in progress. Use the percentages to compare relative increases in obligation flow across industries rather than to infer absolute market size beyond the reported $225B total.

sections.heading: Which industries grew fastest in FY2026 to date?
sections.body: Commercial and Institutional Building Construction grew 181.7% year over year. Highway, Street, and Bridge Construction grew 175.3% year over year. Process, Physical Distribution, and Logistics Consulting Services grew 116.4% year over year. The ranked top ten also include Automobile Manufacturing (97.7%), Offices of Physicians (except Mental Health Specialists) (64.9%), Other Heavy and Civil Engineering Construction (42.4%), Research and Development in Biotechnology (except Nanobiotechnology) (42.0%), Software Publishers (40.5%), Water and Sewer Line and Related Structures Construction (36.1%), and Guided Missile and Space Vehicle Manufacturing (34.1%).

sections.heading: How should readers interpret these growth percentages?
sections.body: The percentages report year-over-year change in federal contract obligations for the same fiscal period. The figures are obligations; current-year totals are partial because the fiscal year is not complete. Use the percentages to compare relative growth in obligation flow across markets, not to infer total contract dollar volume beyond the reported $225B total. The ranking does not indicate long-term trends or causal factors.
